cases.question: Does a supported host deterministically begin Fuli task context before model work?

Are parent local-only facts blocked from children?

Does RELATED_TO avoid expanding retrieval scope?
Does a child's same-key rule override its parent?
Does an ambiguous workspace path stop instead of guessing a child project?
Can current, superseded, reason, and time be distinguished?
Are selection, rejected alternatives, reason, authority, and validation linked and retrievable?
Are equally authoritative conflicts withheld until context-relevant resolution?
Does a one-off pending preference remain search-only?
Does replaying the same episode avoid duplicate knowledge?
Can direct-child common candidates be found without a write or inherited-result contamination?
Does preview require explicit human rationale and bind the exact intent?
Does one Provider mutation promote the canonical item and replace duplicates atomically?
Does bounded negative evidence lower ranking and flag attention without overriding human authority?
Do real Claude Code entry and stop hooks execute in a clean session?
Can a separate non-persistent session retrieve retained project and parent knowledge?
Does Fuli reduce paired collaboration cost without safety regression?
Does the Agent avoid unrelated-project leakage and stale knowledge after negative evidence?
